notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write the Ecclesiastes 8 notes, because I didn't manage to read any of the sources.

**What happened:**
1. I first tried to open six pages directly: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Ellicott, Gill, the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub, and the NET Bible notes. The tool refused all six, because it only opens addresses that have already turned up in a search.
2. I then ran ten searches to find those addresses. They covered the main commentaries plus verses 2, 11, 15 and 17, Wesley's notes, and the debated readings. But I had hit my limit of tool calls for this turn, so the searches never ran.

That leaves me with no source material at all. Your rules say to report only what the pages say and give a URL for every point, so I haven't written any notes from memory.

**To get the notes done,** ask me again in a new message and I'll start with the searches, then open the pages they return. To fit within the limit, I'd go in this order:
1. **Verse-by-verse sources:** Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub or StudyLight.
2. **Different traditions:** Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu), Ligonier or The Gospel Coalition (Reformed), Spurgeon or Desiring God (Baptist), and LCMS or 1517 (Lutheran). The focus would be verses 2–5 on obeying rulers, verses 11–13 on justice that seems delayed, and verse 15 on enjoying life.
3. **Other views:** the NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey, New Advent (Catholic Encyclopedia and Church Fathers), and Got Questions on how verse 15 is used in popular teaching.

If you'd like, I can also split the chapter into two parts (vv. 1–9 and vv. 10–17) so each turn stays within the limit.
